justification: Assessment returned INVALID with flawed_step 0031, identifying exactly the ground-truth defect: the illegitimate per-row decoupling, the false per-row maximization max{y^T x : a_i^T x <= b_i} = y^T a_i / b_i (it notes the sup is +infinity unless y is a nonnegative multiple of a_i and that x = a_i/b_i need not be feasible), and the resulting false half-space description of the polar at 0047. Its own witness checks out: for S = {x in R : x <= 1}, S-polar = [0,1] (y >= 0 from x -> -infinity, y <= 1 at x = 1) while the claimed formula gives (-infinity, 1]. Its second witness (S = {x_1 <= 1, x_2 <= 1}, box vs. true polar missing y >= 0) is the same instance as ground-truth witness (B). Same defect, valid witnesses.
